# Principle of Locality

## Principles
1. **Temporal Locality**: If a memory location is referenced, it will tend to be referenced again soon (e.g. loops, induction variables).
2. **Spatial Locality**: If a memory location is referenced, nearby locations tend to be referenced soon (e.g. array traversal, sequential code execution).
